04-bee-swarm-census.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed with a colorblind-safe palette, clear typographic hierarchy, companion box plot, and annotated callouts, but the percentile labels visually collide with the subtitle text and the top-earner callouts crowd the upper-right corner near the legend.
04-bee-swarm-census.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate for log-normal income data, dot radii are fixed (no size-encoding lie factor), boxplot uses correct Tukey IQR whiskers, percentile lines are data-driven, and no zero-baseline rule applies to bee swarm; only weakness is the hardcoded domain [14000,550000] rather than d3.extent-derived bounds.
04-bee-swarm-census.stress_test_note: Visualization is effectively static — force simulation is pre-computed and stopped, no brush/zoom/transitions exist, and the only interaction (tooltip) uses unified Pointer Events API which avoids mouse-touch double-trigger; no interaction robustness violations apply.
04-bee-swarm-census.cognitive_load_note: 4-color palette separates cleanly across 400 dots, the shared log axis ties swarm and box plot together without cognitive split, and the only real friction is minor label crowding among the 5 high-income callouts at the right tail.
